name: qkd_seq_xd_sel-x1-COMMIT
purpose: KVE-2/SEQ 10-17 (0cx (3)): store-data select leaf of qkd_seq_static_p; bench = the parent bench (seq_static_prg_bench.sh) incl. the xd_sel select mutant (MUT 5) which FAILs.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_seq_xd_sel #(.W(128), .MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014/qkd_seq_static_prg.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: seq_prg_pass
bench.pass_regex: ^SEQ_PRG PASS layers=36 aq=1188 kvn=72 kc=72 errors=0 mut=0 aq_vs_ref=0..0 kvn_vs_ref=0..0 kc_vs_ref=1..1

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_seq_xd_sel/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_seq_xd_sel/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_seq_xd_sel --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_seq_xd_sel  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: first build: 128-b store-data select of qkd_seq_static_p (x4, hardened once), Q data from the attention programme or the KVN receiver word, one output register. Pin-limited bridge sized to its faces: 43.2 x 21.6 (N 257 pins = 5.9/um, S 128 = 3/um); logic is 128 flops + 128 mux.
